meaning:
παρ-οξύνω
[in LXX for נָאַץ, קָצַף, רָגַז, etc. ;]
1. primarily, but never so in cl., to sharpen (μάχαιραν, Deu.32:41, שָׁנַן).
2. Metaphorical, as always in cl.,
(a) to spur on, stimulate (Arist., Xen., al.);
(b) to provoke, rouse to anger (Deu.9:7, 18, Psa.106:29, al.) : pass., Act.17:16, 1Co.13:5.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Now while Paul waited for them at Athens, his spirit was provoked within him as he saw the city full of idols.
doesn’t behave itself inappropriately, doesn’t seek its own way, is not provoked, takes no account of evil;
